title: DelegationRevokeRequest
description: The input of delegation.revoke: the canonical URI of the slip to tear up, and the person's reason, which the log keeps (step 25's README, decision D1). This tutorial's own schema: the specification names no operation that revokes a delegation. The field is slip, never delegation: line ③ reads a delegation field as a claim of the authority the call runs under, and refuses one that is not the caller's (DSOR-SRC-02b; step 25's README, decision D11). The pattern is the specification's resourceUri; the /delegation/ part beside it is this tutorial's.

reason.description: Why the slip is torn up, in the person's own words, for the people who read the log.
